references.text: Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them, which illustrates the practice of the priestly blessing
The tribe of Levi was chosen to bless in the Lord's name
The priests, the sons of Levi, shall bless in the Lord's name
The Levites' task included blessing in the Lord's name forever
The Levitical priests stood and blessed the people, and God heard their voice
Jesus lifted his hands and blessed the disciples, a parallel to the priestly blessing
Melchizedek blessed Abraham, showing that the lesser is blessed by the greater
